title: A systematic literature review (SLR) on the adoption of artificial intelligence-assisted SLRS: implications for health technology assessments

live_model.evidence: Summary table of reviewed studies: "GPT-4 Turbo Data extraction Yes High" -- describes a THIRD-PARTY study's tool use, not an experiment by this paper's authors

claim.metric: none (this is a systematic literature review tabulating other studies' LLM usage; the authors do not run GPT-4 Turbo themselves)

data.source: PRISMA-style review of published SLR-automation studies (search strategy described in Methods)

notes: 'GPT-4 Turbo' appears only as a row in the review's summary table of tools used by OTHER systematic reviews (for data extraction / search-strategy / screening tasks); this paper itself performs no LLM experiment.
